reader.requirement: In STRING, identifier-1/literal-1 (including figurative constants) must be treated as sending items and left unchanged, and identifier-3 as the receiving item (a receiving position: a literal or figurative is refused there), for elementary and group receivers, with the SR2-SR6 class restrictions of 1985 applied at their positions.
